info.title: SDA Property Backend API
info.description: Backend-only property inventory, private documents, exclusive property deal reservations, enquiries, leads, follow-ups, visits and scoped reports. Deal amounts are records, not payment collection. Staff stay/room inventory, calendar-date availability and offline stay bookings are documented in STAYS.md.

post.summary: Reserve one property for a lead customer
post.description: Requires deals.create + deals.view / deals:write. Writes additionally require properties + properties.edit and properties:read + properties:write. Reserve/confirm also require leads.view + leads:read. Sources must be visible for actual changes; cancellation does not need lead access. All-permission roles still obey token and record scopes. Requires available inventory and an open lead with customer. Property/lead/customer/purpose/currency snapshots derived server-side; amount strings normalized exactly. Status becomes reserved and public catalogue/enquiries exclude the property. Parent locking/current reads and a unique active-property guard serialize bookings. Financial fields immutable; audit and inventory changes are atomic. No payment/refund processing. Existing matching request returns the same scoped deal without repeating mutations.

patch.description: Requires deals.confirm + deals.view / deals:write. Reserved becomes confirmed; property becomes sold (sale) or rented (rent). Revalidates current sources, hold, purpose/rental period and customer identity. Does not change CRM lead stage or transfer money. Writes additionally require properties + properties.edit and properties:read + properties:write. Reserve/confirm also require leads.view + leads:read. Sources must be visible for actual changes; cancellation does not need lead access. All-permission roles still obey token and record scopes. Repeating the same terminal action preserves timestamps, reasons and events. Confirmed/cancelled deals cannot reopen or change terminal state. Reserved property deletion is blocked; controlled status/purpose/rental period cannot be changed by ordinary property PUT.

post.summary: Create my confirmed reservation without online payment
post.description: Requires both customer:bookings and customer:bookings:create. Older customer sessions must sign in again. Five creations per minute per IP. Uses shared staff inventory locks and price calculation; insufficient inventory returns 422. UUID binds normalized payload and authenticated owner: exact replay returns current owned booking with 200, fresh reservation 201, changed payload/other owner/staff UUID 409. Preserve UUID on uncertain network/server failure; check My bookings before starting again after reload. Creates zero advance, no payment receipt; created_by and staff actor_id are null with explicit customer_actor_id/customer_created history. Never trusts client ownership. New source must be active/published; replay remains possible after unpublication or cancellation. New reservations require email_verified_at; unverified accounts receive 422 email validation. Quotes, owned reads and exact prior UUID replay remain available.

post.summary: Request staff-reviewed cancellation of my booking
post.description: Requires customer:bookings and customer:bookings:create. Explicit ownership only; no verified-email requirement. One pending request per booking, before its local arrival date and prior to check-in. New UUID/reason returns 201; same customer/booking/trimmed reason/key returns current request with 200 even after terminal decisions/source changes. Different payload/key while pending returns 409. Retain UUID after uncertain outcomes. Pending/rejected requests leave booking, money and allocation unchanged. Five submissions/min/IP. Read history in own booking detail; no automatic email or refund.

patch.summary: Approve or reject a cancellation request
patch.description: Requires stay-bookings.cancel, stay-bookings.view and bookings:write; scoped booking and source checks. Body decision approve/reject plus required customer-visible decision_reason. Exact same terminal decision/reason replays without duplicate events; any changed terminal decision/reason returns 409. Approval calls the same locked staff cancellation transition, releases scheduled inventory, makes amount due zero and preserves all ledger entries/refund due; it never refunds money. Rejection keeps confirmed booking and permits a fresh customer UUID request. Direct staff cancellation/check-in closes a pending request with history. Approval after local arrival date fails 422; staff can still reject. Parent/room/booking/request locks serialize competing decisions.

LeadReportCounts.description: Leads created within the period. Current stage code determines outcome; missing stage is unclassified. Not a historical status report.

FollowUpReportCounts.description: Distinct tasks linked to visible leads, filtered by due date. Overdue means pending with due date strictly before as_of. Notes excluded; undated tasks included only without date bounds.

VisitReportCounts.description: Visits filtered by starts_at. Current status buckets; upcoming means scheduled with starts_at >= as_of.

ReportPeriod.description: Inclusive calendar-day filters in the configured application timezone. Null bounds are unbounded.

OverviewReport.description: Null means missing source ACL/token ability; permitted empty sections have zero counts.

original_name.description: Sanitized download filename with normalized extension, not a storage path.

download_url.description: Relative API download URL; requires Authorization header and current scope.

file.description: Single PDF/JPEG/PNG, up to 10 MiB. Actual MIME must match pdf/jpg/jpeg/png extension. Maximum 50 active documents per property.

request_id.description: Client-generated idempotency key. Same creator and equivalent payload replay existing deal with 200, including terminal deals. Different payload/creator is 409.

agreed_price.description: Positive negotiated total commitment, maximum 9999999999999.99. Must be a decimal string; JSON numbers rejected.

booking_amount.description: Recorded advance included in agreed total, at most agreed_price. Not online payment or a separate security deposit.

balance.description: Current outstanding amount, max(amount_due - net_paid, 0). Cancelled bookings have zero amount_due.
Current outstanding amount, max(amount_due - net_paid, 0). Cancelled bookings have zero amount_due.

cancellation_requests.description: Complete chronological history on detail/create responses; omitted on list summaries.

amount.description: Positive exact decimal string; maximum 9999999999999.99. No actual payment is initiated.
Positive exact decimal string; maximum 9999999999999.99. No actual payment is initiated.

effective.description: False for reversal rows and reversed original entries.

photos.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MiB each.

remove_images.description: Only paths currently owned by this exact gallery.

StayContentWrite.description: Replaces text/amenities/publication; omitted text becomes empty and omitted amenities clears the list. Existing photos retained unless explicitly removed. No inventory, rate, owner or activation changes.

password.description: At most 72 UTF-8 bytes and no null characters; new passwords also need 12+ characters, uppercase/lowercase letters and a number.
At most 72 UTF-8 bytes and no null characters; new passwords also need 12+ characters, uppercase/lowercase letters and a number.

CustomerProfileWrite.description: Only name and phone editable. Omitted phone clears it. Email, status and staff privileges are never changed.

current_password.description: At most 72 UTF-8 bytes and no null characters; new passwords also need 12+ characters, uppercase/lowercase letters and a number.

password.description: At most 72 UTF-8 bytes and no null characters; new passwords also need 12+ characters, uppercase/lowercase letters and a number.

CustomerPasswordWrite.description: New password must differ from current password. Success revokes all customer tokens and requires a new login.

cancellation_requests.description: Complete chronological history on detail/create responses; omitted on list summaries.

CustomerStayBooking.description: Explicit customer_id ownership only. No guest contacts, internal notes, bank references, staff IDs, request IDs, hashes or history events. Old email snapshots never grant ownership.

CustomerReservationWrite.description: Send the exact quoted nightly rate. Ownership, staff creator, totals, advance, currency, status, email and internal notes cannot be supplied. Verify customer email before new reservation.

password.description: Uppercase, lowercase and a number; at most 72 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL.

password_confirmation.description: Uppercase, lowercase and a number; at most 72 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL.

StayCancellationRequest.description: Curated customer-visible request and staff response. No ownership IDs, UUID, hash, staff identity, contacts or internal notes.
